# Machines: load, set, collect
[textlink="Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="Make equipment" link="CMUGuideIndustryRecipes"]
## The common controls — OOC Place the machine and supply its [textlink="power" link="CMUGuideIndustryElectric"] or [textlink="steam" link="CMUGuideIndustrySteam"]. Click it with an empty hand to open the window.
[bold]Read its recipe list → hold ingredient → click input slot → set circuit → collect output.[/bold] Recipes run automatically when the listed items, fluids and catalysts are available. Use the circuit +/- buttons where a recipe requests a number. An empty hand retrieves a slot's contents. Keep output slots and fluid outlets clear.
## Which machine do I need?
- [bold]Wiremill / bender:[/bold] ingots to wire or sheets. Lathe, cutter and extruder make rods, bolts and other shaped parts. - [bold]Polarizer / circuit assembler / assembler / fabricator:[/bold] magnets, circuits, components and finished equipment. The fabricator has extra input slots for complex builds. - [bold]Ore washer / thermal centrifuge / magnetic separator:[/bold] improve ore/powder recovery. Sifter preserves gems; autoclave grows them from powder. - [bold]Electric smelter:[/bold] load metal and set its temperature high enough. Blast furnace and arc furnace handle their listed high-heat recipes. - [bold]Extractor / pyrolysis oven:[/bold] resin, rubber and coke. Mixer, reactor, chemical bath, centrifuge and electrolyzer process fluids and mixtures. - [bold]Compressor / fluid solidifier:[/bold] compress solids or turn molten fluids into usable material. Galvanic bath coats metal. - [bold]Laser engraver / jeweler's bench:[/bold] chips and jewelry. Fit the recipe's lens/catalyst; reusable catalysts stay in the machine. - [bold]Concrete mixer:[/bold] supply water plus the listed dust/sand; add rods for reinforced concrete. Use the resulting bags to build. - [bold]Fertilizer mixer / automatic growing tray:[/bold] pipe the prepared fertilizer to the powered tray. - [bold]Cannery / sewing machine / tannery / pharmaceutical machine:[/bold] food, clothing, leather and medical supplies. Check recipes before choosing inputs. - [bold]Leather supply:[/bold] order a cow crate from colony requisitions under Food and Drinks. Butcher a dead cow for its hide, then tan it with water and chrome powder. Cotton bolls can be sliced with a knife or glass shard for fiber; weave the fiber by hand or in a sewing machine for cloth. - [bold]Recycler:[/bold] consumes an item to recover some of its material. Check what you are inserting.
## Blueprint assembly bench
Activate the blueprint in hand and choose a recipe. Insert it and a charged cell into the assembly machine. Match the ingredient positions in its nine-slot layout, not just the total amount. Speed/efficiency modules go in upgrade slots.
## Automate after one successful batch Enable [bold]Auto input / Auto output[/bold] where available and place supply/output containers or conveyors within reach. Set filters to restrict items; [bold]no filters selected means all allowed[/bold]. Place belt tiles from a belt stack and check their direction before feeding them.
